experiment: E55 pure-EEG true online PGD7 on every current fit and OE mini-batch

model.input: 1x18x1200 raw EEG; per-trial differentiable channelwise linear detrend, median centering and 1.4826*MAD scaling with RMS fallback
model.prototypes: E53/E54 trainable normalized identity prototypes initialized by initial-model fit-known class means; OE-only subjects never initialize or directly update prototypes
model.arpl_definition: E53/E54 two-sided margin ranking on true-class and nearest-other cosine distance with trainable softplus class radii; no unknown class

outlier_exposure.formula: lambda_u * mean(softplus((r_u-r_y+m)/T)); r=max_k z dot mu_k; clean and adversarial paired terms each weighted 0.5
outlier_exposure.unknown_prototype_gradient: detach registered prototypes on the r_u branch so OE-only samples constrain only the encoder away from registered prototypes
outlier_exposure.oe_attack_labels: current-model pseudo-labels only for the online PGD objective; never identity supervision or prototype initialization

training.target_rule: next identity in the sorted enrolled-class cycle; optimization after attack always uses the true fit identity; OE uses current pseudo-labels only for its attack objective
training.early_stopping_data: corresponding inner clean known/calibration-unknown and lightweight attacks only; never OE-only, outer or Test
training.selection_rule: maximize complete lightweight-proxy Score at clean known acceptance >=0.95, then direct C, clean AUROC, U@95, earlier epoch
training.train_fit_definition: mean and minimum of the ten inner fit-known training accuracies; strict gate requires every fold exactly 1.0; no final all-20 OE model

smoke.scope: outer1/inner1 all fit and paired OE batches in both epochs; no model selection
required_invariants: actual seven PGD steps per fit/OE batch
GPU peak memory and throughput recorded

protocol.inner_known: same 8 enrolled identities and 0.6*maximum < trial <=0.8*maximum; continuous file-block proxy
protocol.oe_only: 4 pseudo-unknown identities disjoint from enrolled/calibration/outer; trial <=0.6*maximum; paired OE loss only
protocol.calibration_unknown: other 4 pseudo-unknown identities; trial <=0.8*maximum; thresholds and unknown evaluation only
protocol.role_exclusion: outer, enrolled, OE-only and calibration/eval-unknown subject sets are pairwise disjoint within every inner fold
protocol.subset_rule: sort each eligible subject/task group by trial/path and take first 8 without outcome-based sampling
protocol.aggregation: threshold selected separately within each outer group by pooling its two inner runs; report pair and ten-fold means
protocol.outer_rule: run once only for a preregistered variant passing every inner gate; if both pass select higher inner Score without outer feedback
protocol.outer_transfer: select the better corresponding inner model using inner-only early metrics, freeze its backbone, build 16 registered prototypes from outer-development fit data (trial <=0.8*maximum), perform no OE on enrolled or outer subjects, and freeze the corresponding inner threshold

attacks.radius: per-trial L2 norm after channelwise temporal demeaning divided by 10^(SNR/20)
attacks.pgd_step: 2*radius/steps with L2-normalized gradient and per-trial L2 projection
attacks.fgsm_step: one L2-normalized gradient step to radius
attacks.differentiable_chain: raw waveform -> per-trial detrend/MAD -> EEGNet -> L2 embedding -> normalized prototype cosine logits
attacks.cache_rule: E55 artifacts only; every formal attack is generated against the restored current fold/variant complete model; config/script/model/attack fingerprints are checked

threshold.constraint: pooled corresponding inner clean known acceptance >=0.95
threshold.objective: maximize macro Score=100*C^0.40*A^0.35*U^0.25 across all six attacks using known+attacks+calibration unknown only; ties by RA, ASafeR, C, U, configured score order
threshold.q05: retain clean-known fifth percentile for U@95
threshold.unknown_definition: clean Train calibration/eval pseudo-unknown only; OE-only excluded

e54_oe_baseline.reference: E54 oe, identical subject split seeds and roles; cached PGD3 refreshed every 5 epochs; values are inner fold means

reporting.auc: larger confidence means known; unknown AUPR uses negated confidence
reporting.evidence_boundary: Train-only pseudo-unknown and continuous file-block proxy, not cross-session or official-new-subject evidence; OE-only is not unknown evaluation; Test=N/A
